  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi …（TFA-92593 AC 2；TFA-92593 AC 3；TFA-92593 AC 6；TFA-92593 AC 9；UAT 3.4；UAT TC-17）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Nursing Home resident whose only potassium value is stored as '4', with no unit

When Type the question 'What was the potassium?' in the Post-Round Ask sheet

Then The answer gives the potassium as stored, with no unit added

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：mustInclude 'potassium'; mustNotInclude the units a model may add (3.4: no guessed units on ambiguous values). Runs the Hospital context builder until RG-NH is closed, so it counts for grounding, not for the Nursing Home code path. aiCheck group TC-17-ask
